t: The Filter Module is a very versatile item that can be used to whitelist or blacklist items for the machine. Various machines support this module (Builder, Modular Storage, Crafter, ...)$(br2)Blocks, items, and tags are supported. You can blacklist or whilelist and also require mathing on NBT and damage
过滤模块是一种非常多功能的物品，可用于为机器设置物品白名单或黑名单。多种机器支持该模块（建筑机、模块化存储、自动合成机，等等）。$(br2)支持方块、物品和标签。你可以设置黑名单或白名单，也可以要求匹配 NBT 和耐久值。

$(5)Sneak right click$() on an inventory (like a chest) to add all items/block in that inventory to the filter.$(br)$(5)Sneak right click$() on a block in the world to add that block to the filter.$(br2)In the GUI of the filter module you can also add tags or convert a block/item to the corresponding tags
$(5)潜行右键$()点击一个容器（如箱子），可将该容器中的所有物品/方块加入过滤器。$(br)$(5)潜行右键$()点击世界中的一个方块，可将该方块加入过滤器。$(br2)在过滤模块的 GUI 中，你还可以添加标签，或将方块/物品转换为对应的标签。
